## Validation

- [ ] Names, dates, publication metadata and image credits checked against the sources.
- [ ] `npm run validate:content`, `npm run build` and `npm run check` pass.
- [ ] Relevant desktop and mobile page reviewed.
- [ ] Drafts remain drafts until the content owner approves publication.
